applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse on a side's cited-in line as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it says the cited verses were answered and leaves the link underdetermined.
quote: [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge treats the cited verses as answered and does not count any unanswered witness toward a broken link.
